# New-ZbxActionCondition

## SYNOPSIS

Builds an action condition for the -Filter conditions of New-ZbxAction and Set-ZbxAction.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxActionCondition [-ConditionType] <ZabbixActionConditionType> [-FormulaId <string>] [-Operator <ZabbixConditionOperator>] [-Value <string>] [-Value2 <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A condition decides which events an action reacts to: a host group, a trigger severity, a tag value and so on. The New-ZbxActionCondition cmdlet writes it as a hashtable keyed by the API's field names, which the -Filter conditions of New-ZbxAction and Set-ZbxAction take as it is, alone or in an array. -ConditionType is positional. Nothing is sent to the server, so the command needs no connection.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Build a condition and use it in a new action

```powershell
$severity = New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType TriggerSeverity -Operator MoreEqual -Value 5
$notify = New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType Message -OperationMessageGroup (Get-ZbxUserGroup -Name 'Operators') -OperationMessage @{ default_msg = 1 }
New-ZbxAction -Name 'Notify on disaster' -EventSource Triggers -Filter @{ evaltype = 'AndOr'; conditions = @($severity) } -Operation $notify |
    Select-Object ActionId, Name, Status
```

The builder only writes a hashtable in the wire shape of one filter condition; nothing reaches the server until New-ZbxAction sends it in -Filter. Operator MoreEqual with value 5 reads "severity is Disaster or higher".

### Example 2: Combine several conditions with a custom formula

```powershell
$conditions = @(
    New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType HostGroup -Operator Equal -Value (Get-ZbxHostGroup -Name 'Web servers').GroupId -FormulaId A
    New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType TriggerSeverity -Operator MoreEqual -Value 4 -FormulaId B
    New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType EventTagValue -Operator Equal -Value2 'env' -Value 'prod' -FormulaId C
)
$notify = New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType Message -OperationMessageGroup (Get-ZbxUserGroup -Name 'Operators') -OperationMessage @{ default_msg = 1 }
$null = New-ZbxAction -Name 'Web alerts' -EventSource Triggers -Filter @{ evaltype = 'Expression'; formula = 'A and (B or C)'; conditions = $conditions } -Operation $notify
(Get-ZbxAction -Name 'Web alerts' -SelectFilter).Filter.conditions | Format-Table formulaid, conditiontype, operator, value, value2
```

-FormulaId labels each condition so the filter's formula can refer to it; -Value2 carries the tag name of an EventTagValue condition, -Value its value. Get-ZbxAction -SelectFilter reads the stored filter back.

## PARAMETERS

### -FormulaId

Arbitrary unique identifier, such as a capital letter, that refers to this condition from a custom filter expression; required only when the filter uses a custom expression.
